sources.finding: v4 no longer auto-detects JavaScript config; @config is explicit; corePlugins is unsupported.
Use separate theme and utilities imports and omit preflight. source(none) belongs on utilities.
@theme inline places the referenced value in utilities, avoiding alias resolution at the wrong scope.
Official attribute example activates from a matching dark ancestor; it does not define nearest-theme boundary semantics.
Custom variants support nested rules with @slot.
Scoped styles define inclusive roots and exclusive lower boundaries; used here as an optional design, not a Tailwind guarantee.
Nested @scope and nested declarations have specific semantics, so browser-level checks are required beyond compilation.
@scope availability is newer than Tailwind v4 minimum browsers; inheritance is not blocked at the scope boundary.
npm view observed latest 4.3.3 and v3-lts 3.4.19.
